sections.heading: Object
items: Be the first to score 500 points by being the first to get rid of all your cards each hand.

sections.heading: Players & Deck
items: 108-card deck: 4 colours (Red / Yellow / Green / Blue), each with one 0, two each of 1–9, two Skip, two Reverse, two Draw Two; plus 4 Wild and 4 Wild Draw Four.

sections.heading: Dealing
items: Each player draws a card; highest deals (action cards count as 0).
Dealer shuffles and deals 7 cards each.
Remaining cards form the Draw Pile; flip the top card to start the Discard Pile.

First-card specials — Wild: dealer chooses colour. Wild Draw Four: return to deck and pick another. Draw Two: first player draws 2 and skips. Reverse: play starts with dealer. Skip: first player loses turn.
Who goes first is configurable in the rule library (default: player to the dealer's left).

sections.heading: How to play a card
items: On your turn, play one card matching the top discard by colour, number, or symbol — or play a Wild.

sections.heading: Action Cards
items: Reverse — reverse direction. In a 2-player game, acts as a Skip.
Skip — next player loses their turn.
Draw Two — next player draws 2 and loses their turn.
Wild — change the colour of play; may be played on any turn even if you have other playable cards.
Wild Draw Four — change colour AND next player draws 4 and loses their turn.

sections.heading: Calling "UNO"
items: When you play your second-to-last card, yell "UNO!". The penalty for forgetting is configurable in the rule library.

sections.heading: Scoring (points reference)
items: How you win is configurable in the rule library (default: points).

When using points scoring, the winner of each hand scores all opponents' remaining cards: number cards = face value; Draw Two / Reverse / Skip = 20 each; Wild / Wild Draw Four = 50 each. First to 500 points wins.
When using wins-based scoring, just count hand wins.
